integrity: The proof and source comparisons were subjected to same-model review only; independent mathematical audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nontrivial finite groups of prime exponent, counting-free FO2, the named-identity ternary graph-of-multiplication language; no statement on composite exponents, function-symbol multiplication, or counting. The FO3 claim is only an explicit noncommutativity separation. Finite test data corroborate but cannot prove all-group equivalence; historical priority provisional.
title: Six two-variable theories of finite prime-exponent groups
